Interface Middleware<F>

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Middleware<F>
Wraps an app: cross-cutting behaviour (errors, request ids, logging, timeouts, CORS, auth) as plain function composition. Applies to a whole HttpApp or, with Routes.through(Middleware), to every route of a group while keeping the group's trie.
